Definition: from G1909 and an equivalent of G833; a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling:--habitation.
BiblicalUsage: Epaulis is a habitation, a dwelling place. Peter quotes the psalm over Judas: let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein — the empty house of a man who betrayed his Master and left his place vacant.
TheologicalSignificance: An empty habitation is a sober picture of what betrayal costs, I hold: a place prepared, then left desolate.
